memories.content: The legal team has received the revised supplier contract today (2026-08-18) and must review it for clearance. They have their own internal processes and priorities, and may have other pending work.

The revised supplier contract has been submitted to Veldt Solar's legal team for review and clearance before signature. The deadline for clearance is ten working days from today, i.e., by 2026-09-01 (assuming no holidays). The hard cutoff for the simulation is 2026-09-01T17:00:00+02:00.
